title: 第二十三章 道心坚如磐石必须杀人夺宝第二十四章 三位道友怎地离在下如此之远
slug: 看守废丹房三年我偷偷成仙了
lines: 县衙门口，两名捕快按刀守着大门，一名炼气期十二层的青衣老者盘坐在鸣冤鼓旁。
凡有修士欲要进入县衙，只要被他看上一眼，确认修为在身，便可进入。
而等秦凡进了县衙，在门口候着的下人便立马恭敬上前：
“见过仙师，仙师可是要在县衙落脚？”
秦凡点了点头，接着问道：“县衙内如今有多少道友在此？”
“有二三十位吧，不过有的出去办事了，暂时不在衙门里。”
“那他们都是散修？”
“不都是，还有些附近仙门的仙师，他们有的和仙师您一样年轻。”
秦凡点头了然，然后在下人的领路下，往县衙后院客房走去。
一路穿廊过院，也碰见了几个修士，皆是炼气期五六层的，据他神识探查，这县衙内最厉害的修士，便是炼气期十二层大圆满。
筑基初期的修士，明面上一个没有，暗地里仅有他一个。
也不排除有人和他一样隐藏了修为，也或许外出的人里有筑基期修士，可在秦凡看来，这般概率并不大。
据下人所说，狼妖目前最厉害的一头，是三天前出现的，是一头十二级的妖兽。
相当于炼气期十二层的修为。
如果这一情况没有变化的话，那么以县衙内现在的力量，足够将狼妖们一网打尽。
请筑基期修士过来完全没那个必要，毕竟出手一趟也挺贵的。
别以为修士下山除妖是献爱心来了，须知对修士而言，时间是最为宝贵的。
没好处，谁肯浪费时间帮你拼命。
当然了，也不排除有侠义之士，可这般人，毕竟都是少数。
大部分都冲朝廷悬赏来的。
圣地也是一样，只不过圣地拿的那份，胥国皇室早都交完了。
可就算如此，圣地何时出人帮忙，也要看圣地内的弟子心情。
真要没人愿意接这个任务，你也没辙。
世道就是如此，没实力就是桌上的凉菜热菜，有实力你就是看菜单的那个。
没过多久，下人便带秦凡来到了一处厢房客院，院内布置比较简单，没太多装点，仅有一株桃树，在桃树旁还有一套青石桌凳。
此时有两男一女，正坐在石桌旁饮酒聊天，望见秦凡到来，皆是有些意外。
三人一同站了起来，其中一个相貌清俊的年轻修士好奇问道：“道友看着有些面生，莫非是刚来此地？”
秦凡点了点头，对年轻修士自我介绍道：“在下王大彪，乃一介散修，不知三位道友如何称呼？”
散修？
一听秦凡这话，三人神情皆是微动，随后脸上全都浮现出了笑容。
“在下何修文，灵光山外门弟子。”
相貌清俊的年轻修士轻轻一笑，对秦凡拱手说道。
紧接着，转头看向旁边的白衣修士和绿衣女子分别介绍道：“这位是我师兄陆恒，师妹陈滢，与我一样，他们也都是炼气期七层修为。”
“两位道友有礼了。”秦凡轻轻颔首。
陈滢轻笑了笑，道：“王道友此来可是有些晚了，这院内房间只剩角落那一间小的，王道友若要住在此地，恐怕要委屈道友一晚了。”
“不碍事。”
秦凡轻笑道：“我对房间大小没什么要求。”
“道友不嫌弃就好。”
陈滢点了点头。
“明日一早，我等会在衙门捕头的领路下去往城外大青山杀妖，道友可要与我等一起进山？”
content_en:
At the gate of the county government office, two detectives guarded the gate with their swords pressed, and an old man in green clothes who was at the twelfth level of Qi refining stage sat cross-legged next to the drum of injustice.
Any monk who wants to enter the county government office can enter as long as he takes a look at him and confirms his cultivation level.
When Qin Fan entered the county government office, the servants waiting at the door immediately came forward respectfully:
"I've met the immortal master. Is the immortal master going to settle down in the county government?"
"Yeah."
Qin Fan nodded and then asked: "How many fellow Taoists are here in the county government now?"
"There are probably twenty or thirty of them, but some of them have gone out to do business and are not in the Yamen for the time being."
"Then they are all casual cultivators?"
"Not all, there are some immortal masters from nearby immortal sects, some of them are as young as you, the immortal master."
Qin Fan nodded in understanding, and then led the way to the guest room in the backyard of the county government office.
Walking through the corridor and passing through the courtyard, he also met several monks, all of whom were at the fifth or sixth level of the Qi Refining Stage. According to his spiritual exploration, the most powerful monk in the county government was the 12th level Dzogchen of the Qi Refining Stage.
Among the monks in the early stage of foundation building, there was no one on the surface, but he was the only one secretly.
It is not ruled out that there are people who hide their cultivation like him, or there may be foundation-building monks among those who go out, but in Qin Fan's opinion, the probability of this is not high.
According to the servants, the most powerful wolf monster currently appeared three days ago and was a level 12 monster.
It is equivalent to the cultivation level of the twelfth level in the Qi refining stage.
If this situation does not change, then the current power within the county government will be enough to wipe out all the wolf monsters.
There is absolutely no need to invite the foundation-building monks to come over. After all, it is quite expensive to take action.
Don't think that monks come down the mountain to slay demons to show their love. You should know that for monks, time is the most precious.
It's no good, no one is willing to waste time to help you fight.
Of course, it is not ruled out that there are chivalrous people, but such people are in the minority after all.
Most of them came with rewards from the imperial court.
The same goes for the Holy Land, except that the royal family of the Xu Kingdom had already handed over the portion that the Holy Land received.
But even so, when the Holy Land sends someone to help, it also depends on the mood of the disciples in the Holy Land.
If no one is willing to take on this task, you have nothing to do.
This is the way the world is. If you don't have the ability, you will be the hot and cold dishes on the table. If you have the ability, you will be the one reading the menu.
Not long after, the servants took Qin Fan to a guest courtyard. The courtyard was relatively simple, without much decoration. There was only a peach tree and a set of bluestone tables and benches next to the peach tree.
At this time, two men and one woman were sitting at the stone table drinking and chatting. They were all a little surprised when they saw Qin Fan arriving.
The three of them stood up together, and one of them, a handsome young monk, asked curiously: "Fellow Taoist looks a little unfamiliar, could it be that he just came here?"
"Yeah."
Qin Fan nodded and introduced himself to the young monk: "I, Wang Dabiao, am a casual cultivator. What do you call these three fellow Taoists?"
Casual cultivator?
Upon hearing Qin Fan's words, the expressions of the three of them moved slightly, and then smiles appeared on their faces.
"I'm He Xiuwen, a disciple of the outer sect of Lingguang Mountain."
The handsome young monk smiled softly and said to Qin Fan.
Then, he turned to look at the monk in white and the woman in green beside him and introduced respectively: "This is my senior brother Lu Heng and my junior sister Chen Ying. Like me, they are also at the seventh level of Qi Refining Stage."
"You two Taoists are polite." Qin Fan nodded lightly.
Chen Ying smiled softly and said: "Fellow Daoist Wang is here a little late. There is only one small room in the corner left in this courtyard. If you want to stay here, Daoist Wang, I'm afraid you will have to suffer for one night."
"It's out of the way."
Qin Fan chuckled and said, "I don't have any requirements on the size of the room."
"It's fine, fellow Taoist, if you don't dislike it."
Chen Ying nodded.
"Early tomorrow morning, I will lead the way to Daqing Mountain outside the city to kill monsters under the leadership of the Yamen Chief. Do fellow Taoists want to go into the mountain with us?"
title_en: Chapter 23: The Taoist heart is as solid as a rock and must kill people to seize the treasure. Chapter 24: How come the three Taoist friends are so far away from me?
